title.label: Same Minecraft, Ruined by Poor Optimization

content.label: I’d wanted to buy Minecraft for my iPad Pro M5 for a very long time, but I ended up disappointed… The game’s optimization is terrible: with the new graphics, the FPS is unstable, it’s not enjoyable to play, and there are constant stutters and other issues. And these are far from the highest settings for the new graphics. Keep in mind that I’m using a device with an M5 chip; I dread to imagine what it’s like on an iPhone with an A-series chip… Even with the old graphics, there are occasional micro-stutters, which, in my opinion, is unacceptable. Without a gamepad or a mouse and keyboard, it’s impossible to play. I remember that back in the day, touchscreen controls in Pocket Edition were much more responsive and convenient. Other than that, it’s the same Minecraft, but considering the optimization, I’d think twice before spending my money on it…
